title: Agent Feedback Acknowledgement
description: Body of a 202 response to POST /feedback.

known_issue.description: Present when the service already tracks this problem. Agents can use it to stop retrying or to apply a known workaround.

fixed_at.description: When status is fixed: when the fix shipped.

note.description: Written by a person on the service's team: what changed and how to use it now.
